blurb: Maximalist artist Les Harris set out on a labyrinthine journey 45 years ago. Choosing to install his artwork rather than sell, his one room studio grew exponentially into a massive installation, drawing visitors from throughout the world. To view the artwork, link to “Gallery of Art” to the right here.
